title: Add paginated HTML product table to FastAPI products API
description: Brownfield Python/FastAPI task: add a GET /products/ui endpoint that renders an HTML table of products with page and per_page query parameters.

task_spec.prompt:
Add a GET /products/ui endpoint to src/app.py. All 3 existing tests must still pass. @app.get("/products/ui", response_class=HTMLResponse) def products_ui(page: int = Query(1, ge=1), per_page: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100)) -> HTMLResponse — imports: from fastapi import Query; from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse — slice PRODUCTS based on page and per_page — render an HTML page with: *

Products

*

Page {page} of {total_pages} ({total} total)

* with columns: ID, Name, Category, Price (formatted as $X.XX) — default: page=1, per_page=10 — IMPORTANT: register /products/ui BEFORE /products/{product_id} in the file, otherwise FastAPI matches /products/ui as /products/ui (integer parse fails → 422) All 3 existing tests must still pass. Run: pytest
required_artifacts: GET /products/ui returns 200 with text/html content type
HTML table contains product ID, Name, Category, Price columns
HTML page shows pagination info (page X of Y, N total)
page=2 per_page=10 returns the second 10 products
followup_prompts: Good. Now handle edge cases: what does the UI show when data is empty, loading, or an error occurs? Add those states and tests.
Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` to verify the complete implementation. Fix any failures and confirm all UI states work correctly.
